website_summary.name: WebMail Service
website_summary.description: The website resembles a modern, user-friendly email client interface with a clean and organized layout.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a sidebar menu on the left with options such as Inbox, Starred, Snoozed, Sent, Drafts, Spam, Trash, and Labels (Work, Personal, Family, Urgent, Important). The main content area displays a list of emails with sender details, subject lines, and brief previews. Emails are categorized with labels like Work, Important, and Personal. Each email entry includes interactive icons for starring, marking as important, and other actions. The top navigation bar contains a search bar, settings icon, help icon, and user profile picture. The overall design is minimalistic with a white background and blue accents.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers various functionalities including composing new emails, searching through existing emails using a search bar, managing emails via archiving, deleting, marking as read/unread, and applying labels. Users can also view detailed email content, download attachments, and navigate between different folders like Inbox, Sent, and Trash. Additionally, there are options for customizing the interface and accessing account settings.
